notes:
What's new

- Animated GIFs play in the preview: frames advance at the file's own timing, and a still GIF simply stays still.
- Large animations are bounded: up to 240 frames and 48 megapixels, otherwise the first frame is shown.
- Multi-page TIFF files (from the previous release) keep their page navigation.
changelog: WinPreview 1.3.22 - animated GIF playback (1E complete). Every frame is decoded once under a 240-frame / 48 MP budget, per-frame delays come from the GIF control extension (handling WIC's byte-swapped value), the animation timer stays awake while playing, and still GIFs keep the static path. 7 new checks.
